item.title: Warner Music Group’s Africori Taps Adam Tiran as GM
item.description:
[Energetic music plays in the background]
Host: Welcome to Trending on Billboard, your source for the latest news in music. I'm your host, [Name], and today we have some exciting news from Africa.
[Short music transition]
Host: Adam Tiran has been appointed as the new general manager of Africori, a leading digital music distribution company in Africa. Based in Johannesburg, Tiran will report to Simon Robson, president of EMEA Recorded Music at Warner Music Group.
[Short pause]
Host: As a 13-year veteran of Africori, Tiran has played a key role in the company's expansion across East, West, and Southern Africa. He's also championed acts like Master KG, Focalistic, and Makhadzi, helping to elevate their careers globally.
[Short music clip]
Host: In a statement, Tiran expressed his excitement about his new role, saying he's committed to empowering independent African artists and investing in local cultures. Simon Robson also praised Tiran's understanding of the African music landscape and his track record in artist development.
[Short pause]
Host: This appointment comes after Yoel Kenan stepped down as CEO of Africori, a company he founded 14 years ago. Under Kenan's leadership, Africori became a key player in Warner Music's global network and launched several successful initiatives, including a joint venture with WM France.
[Short music transition]
Host: Warner Music Group first invested in Africori in 2020 and later acquired a majority stake in 2022. With Tiran at the helm, Africori is set to accelerate its investment in local talent and deepen its footprint across Africa.
[Closing music plays]
Host: That's all for today's episode of Trending on Billboard. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next one!
